αἰδοῖ: αἰδώς — reverence, modesty, courtesy; fem. dat. sg., of manner: ’with modesty’ · also dat. of motive: ’from respect, out of reverence’ (φιλότητι καὶ αἰδοῖ ’from friendship and respect’)
αἰδόμενος: αἴδομαι — feel shame, show regard, respect; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’out of respect, from delicacy’
αὐτόλυκος: Αὐτόλυκος — Autolycus, Odysseus’ maternal grandfather, a master thief; masc. nom. sg.
βάν: βαίνω — step, go, set out; aor. 3 pl., epic (= Attic ἔβησαν)
βιὸν: βιός — bow; masc. acc. sg. (poetic = τόξον; not βίος ’life’)
δυσμενέων: δυσμενέω — be hostile, bear ill will; pres. part. masc. nom. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic δυσμενῶν) · also adj. δυσμενής, -ές — hostile; masc. gen. pl. (ἀνδρῶν δυσμενέων ’of hostile men’)
δόσις: δόσις — giving, a gift; fem. nom. sg.
εὐρυμέτωπον: εὐρυμέτωπος — broad-browed (of cattle); masc./fem. acc. sg. or neut. nom./acc. sg.
θαμέες: θαμέες — thick, close-set, crowded; adj., masc. nom. pl., epic plural form (= Attic θαμεῖς)
θρασυμήδης: Θρασυμήδης — Thrasymedes, son of Nestor; masc. nom. sg.
κέκλυθι: κλύω — hear, listen; imper. 2 sg., reduplicated aorist form, epic: ’hear!’
κέρδος: κέρδος — gain, profit, advantage; neut. nom. sg.
καταδῦναι: καταδύω — go down into, enter, plunge into; aor. inf. act. (intrans.), + acc.: ’to go down among’
κεῖσ: κεῖσε — thither, to that place; adv., elided (κεῖσ’ = κεῖσε)
λέλειπτο: λείπω — leave; plpf. pass. 3 sg., with simple past force: ’had been left behind, was left behind’
λαθοίμην: λανθάνω — mid. λανθάνομαι forget (+ gen.); aor. opt. 1 sg.: ’I could forget’
λεπτὴ: λεπτός — narrow, thin, fine; fem. nom. sg.
λιπέτην: λείπω — leave; aor. dual 3rd pers., unaugmented: ’the two left’
μάλιστά: μάλα — very, much; superl. adv. μάλιστα, accented μάλιστά before a following enclitic (γε): ’most of all, especially’
μέσσῃ: μέσος — middle, mid-; epic μέσσος (doubled σ), fem. dat. sg.
μειλίχιον: μειλίχιος — soothing, gentle, winning; masc. acc. sg.
μεμάασιν: μέμαα — be eager, be intent on, strive (perf. w/ pres. force); 3 pl. μεμάασιν, movable-ν form of μεμάασι: ’they are eager’
μῆτις: μῆτις — cunning intelligence, craft, counsel; fem. nom. sg.
ξεινήϊον: ξεινήϊον — guest-gift, gift of hospitality; neut. nom./acc. sg., epic (= Attic ξένιον)
πίφαυσκον: πιφαύσκω — make known, declare, tell; impf. 1 sg., unaugmented (= ἐπίφαυσκον), reduplicated present stem: ’I kept declaring’
παρίστασαι: παρίσταμαι — stand beside, stand by (+ dat.); pres. 2 sg. mid. of παρίστημι
περιχεύας: περιχέω — pour round, pour over; aor. part. masc. nom. sg.
πρόφρασσα: πρόφρων — eager, willing, ready-minded; fem. nom. sg., epic double σσ (= πρόφρασα)
πύθοιτο: πυνθάνομαι — learn, inquire; aor. opt. 3 sg. mid.
φῆμιν: φῆμις (Ionic-epic φήμη) — report, talk of people, rumour; fem. acc. sg.
χαῖρε: χαίρω — rejoice; pres. imper. 2 sg., the ordinary greeting: ’welcome, hail’ · also impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἔχαιρε): ’he rejoiced’ (χαῖρε φήμῃ ’rejoiced at the omen-word’) · also the imperative at parting: ’farewell’ · also with a dative of cause, ’be glad’ (χαῖρε … φιλότητι ’be glad in love’) · also pres. imper. 2 sg., not a greeting: ’rejoice’ (ἐν θυμῷ … χαῖρε ’rejoice in your heart’)
ἀδμήτην: ἄδμητος — unbroken, untamed, unyoked (ἀ- + δάμνημι ’tame’); fem. acc. sg.
ἀπόπροθεν: ἀπόπροθεν — from afar, far off; adv.
ἀργιόδοντος: ἀργιόδους — white-toothed; adj., masc./fem. gen. sg., epithet of a boar or pig
ἀρείω: ἀρείων — better, more valiant; comparative adj. (of ἀγαθός), masc. acc. sg.
ἀσκηθής: ἀσκηθής — unscathed, unharmed; masc. nom. sg.
ἀφικέσθαι: ἀφικνέομαι — arrive at, reach; aor. inf. mid.: ’to arrive’
ἄκουσαν: ἀκούω — hear, heed; aor. 3 pl., + gen. of the person heard: ’heeded him’
ἐθέλουσα: ἐθέλω — wish, be willing; pres. part. fem. nom. sg.: ’wishing’
ἐκάλυψεν: καλύπτω — cover, wrap; aor. 3 sg., ν-movable; with περί in tmesis, ’wrapped round’
ἐπικρατέουσιν: ἐπικρατέω — hold power over, rule; pres. 3 pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic -οῦσιν), + dat.
ἐσθλή: ἐσθλός — good, noble; fem. nom. sg.
ἐτόλμα: τολμάω — dare, endure, hold out; impf. 3 sg.: ’held out’
ἐϋκλεῖας: ἐϋκλεής — of good fame, well-famed; masc. acc. pl., contracted (= ἐϋκλεέας), subject of the inf. ἔμμεναι
ἑδριόωντο: ἑδριάομαι — sit, take a seat; impf. 3 pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἑδριῶντο)
ἔκτοσθε: ἔκτοσθε(ν) — outside, from outside; adv. (= ἐκτός) · also prep. + gen.: ’out of, away from’ (ἔκτοσθε θαλάσσης ’out of the sea’)
ἔῃ: εἰμί — be; pres. subj. 3 sg., epic ἔῃ (= Attic ᾖ), in a general relative clause: ’is’
ἤϊσαν: εἶμι — go; impf. 3 pl., epic (= Attic ᾖσαν): ’went’
ἦνιν: ἦνις — a year old, yearling (of a calf); rare word, precise sense not certain; fem. acc. sg.
ὀδυσεύς: Ὀδυσσεύς — Odysseus; nom. sg., single-σ metrical variant
ὀτρύνει: ὀτρύνω — urge on, rouse, press; pres. 3 sg.
ὁδοῖο: ὁδός — road, way, journey; gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -οῦ)
ὑπουράνιον: ὑπουράνιος — under the heavens; adj. of two endings, neut. nom. sg., epic one word (Attic ὑπ’ οὐρανῷ)
ᾔει: εἶμι — go; impf. 3 sg., augmented: ’was going, went’
ῥέξω: ῥέζω — do, perform, sacrifice; fut. 1 sg. or aor. subj. 1 sg.: ’I will do, sacrifice’
